title: Aamadh hai Ahlebaith-e-Payamber ki Shaam main
body:
Aamadh hai Ahlebaith-e-Payamber ki Shaam main
Gaysoo khuley huvey hain aza-e-Imam main
Sar peet thi hai Fatema Daarus salaam main
Zainab yeh nauha karthi hai balwaa-e-aam main
<<MINI>>
Logo khabar karo meray naana Rasool ko
Balway main shimrn laaya hai binte Batool ko
<<DIVIDER>>
Naana teri nawaasi kay sar par ridaa nahin
Aur ahley shaam dekhtay hain kuch hayaa nahin
Abid ghareeb marthaa hai taph sey dawaa nahin
Beyhoush nanhey bachchey hain aab-o-ghizaa nahin
<<MINI>>
Dil sab ke kaampthay hain badhan thar tharaathay hain
Ab saamney yazeed kay sadaath jaathey hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hain ek rasan main baara galay waah museebatha
Rothay hain godhiyoun kay palay waah museebatha
Bas main sitamgaroun kay chalay waah museebatha
Khaak-e-aza hain mooh pa malay waah museebatha
<<MINI>>
Mushkil qadam utthaana tha us izdihaam main
Yoon ithrath-e-Nabi gayee balwaa-e-aam main
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab tadap kay oontt pa karthi thi yeh bayaan
Darbaar main talab huvey saadaath naagahaan
Oontoun sey uthri bibiyaan keh keh kay al-Amaan
Peish-e-yazeed ley gaya zaalim kashaan kashaan
<<MINI>>
Saamaan-e-jashn-e-aam tha darbaar-e-aam tha
Aur nangay sar Hussain ka kunbaa tamaam tha
<<DIVIDER>>
Muthrib taraana sanjj thay raqqaas shaadmaan
Padthey thay tehniyath kay qasiday qasidakhawn
Haazir vakeel-e-rome-o-khoothan baashikoh-o-shaan
Haathoun pa nazr fathaa liye khurd aur kalaan
<<MINI>>
Chillaathi thi Batool yeh zulm-e-shadeed hai
Ya Rab teiray Hussain kay marney ki eid hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Naagaah baddkay shimr-e-layeen ney kiya salaam
Bolaa kay aye ameer yeh shaadi ka hai muqaam
Ummeedwaar-e-qallath-o-jaageer hai ghulaam
Haazir hai sar shaheedoun kay aur ithrath-e-anaam
<<MINI>>
Baddkar pukaara murraah kay apna jigar hai yeh
Ley hum shabihey khaas Payambar ka sar hai yeh
<<DIVIDER>>
Wallah iskay ranjo alam main basadh bukaa
Farzandh-e-buturaab bahaathar jagaah giraa
Yeh zikr tha kay hashr ka saamaan hogaya
Ghabraagaya yazeed kay yeh kya ghazab huva
<<MINI>>
Dekha toh hurmulaa bhi bahot shaad aathaa hai
Sar ek chotay bachchey ka haathoun pa laatha hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hai khoon-e-halq halq kay oopar jamaa huva
Nanhaa sa mooh hai pyaas kay maaray khulaa huva
Baachoun main doodh dono taraf hai bharaa huva
Suraaq-e-teer-e-zulm galay main padaa huva
<<MINI>>
Is khoon par yazeed ney jisdum nigaaha ki
Us sey bhi zabth ho na sakaa rokay aaha ki
<<DIVIDER>>
Bolaa bathaao isney bhalaa ki thi kya qathaa
Tu ney isey nishaana kiya teer-e-zulm ka
Bachchey pa bhi na khaaya taras tu ney beyhayaa
Yeh nanhaa sa galaa woh teira naawak-e-jafaa
<<MINI>>
Bathlaa toh kis falak ka yeh mehray muneer hai
Baanu pukaari baddkay yeh mera sagheer hai
<<DIVIDER>>
Hairaan khadey thay sab harum-e-Shaahey Mashraqain
Mohray sukooth labb pa na shikwaa na shor-o-shayn
Zainab ney dekha taqth pa naagaah sar-e-Hussain
Bey saaqthaa tadap kay yeh karney lagi woh bayn
<<MINI>>
Hai hai na mauth aayi mujhey raahey shaam main
Bhaiyya mera salaam lo darbaar-e-aam main
